author: Bobby Grayson
description: funext p f s m; cases s <;> cases m <;> first | rfl | (simp only [Gen.X.beh, beh, lift]; split <;> rfl) | simp [Gen.X.beh, beh, lift]. Plain simp [lift] leaves (if c then .. else ..).fst unreduced; split closes both branches by rfl. All Lock proofs (LockProof, LockFcfs, LockMutants) and Bank.lean's beh_preserves are untouched since they are about the hand-written beh : Behavior.
title: Proof note: beh_eq_gen : Gen.X.beh = lift beh needs a split for the guarded withdraw/release clauses
